meta.title: Algorithmic Panopticon: Gig Economy & Delivery Workers in India

nodes.label: Quick Commerce
nodes.description: 10-minute delivery sector. Valued at $5B+. Dominant model in Indian urban logistics 2021-2025.

nodes.label: Blinkit
nodes.description: Formerly Grofers. India's largest Q-Commerce platform. Acquired by Zomato 2022.

nodes.label: Zepto
nodes.description: Founded by 19-year-old Stanford dropouts. Aggressive supply chain expansion.

nodes.label: Swiggy Instamart
nodes.description: Q-Commerce arm of Swiggy. Negative margins as of 2025.

nodes.label: Zomato
nodes.description: Food delivery super-app. Parent company of Blinkit.

nodes.label: Grofers
nodes.description: Grocery marketplace founded 2013. Pivoted to Blinkit in 2021 under existential pressure.

nodes.label: Dark Store
nodes.description: Micro-warehouse in residential areas (~2,000 sq ft). Optimised for speed, not worker welfare. No public access.

nodes.label: Algorithmic Management
nodes.description: Invisible black-box boss. Assigns orders, sets pay, disciplines — no human oversight, no appeals process.

nodes.label: 10-Minute Promise
nodes.description: Marketing and operational commitment driving the entire Q-Commerce arms race. Achieved via store density, not faster riding.

nodes.label: Gig Worker
nodes.description: Delivery partner archetype. Works 10-16 hrs/day. 43% earn < ₹500/day net after expenses.

nodes.label: Earnings Erosion
nodes.description: Platform payouts have dropped 50%+ in 3 years. 43% of workers earn less than ₹500/day.

nodes.label: Musculoskeletal Disorders
nodes.description: Chronic MSDs from repetitive riding posture, heavy loads, and whole-body vibration.

nodes.label: Chemical Exposure
nodes.description: Chronic urban air pollution exposure. Exhaust smoke and PM2.5 causing respiratory and cardiovascular damage.

nodes.label: Psychological Stress
nodes.description: Perpetual anxiety from algorithmic pressure, IVR harassment, language barriers, and income uncertainty.

nodes.label: Road Safety Risk
nodes.description: Riders forced to speed, jump red lights, ride on pavements to meet algorithmic timers. Leads to accidents.

nodes.label: Throttle Assist
nodes.description: Paddle-shaped clip that reduces grip force. PETG or ASA filament. Lowers tendonitis and carpal tunnel risk.

nodes.label: Ergonomic TPU Grips
nodes.description: Custom grips with palm swell and gyroid infill (15-25%) for vibration dampening. Reduces hand numbness.

nodes.label: Phone Sun Hood
nodes.description: 3D-printed screen visor + rain shield. Prevents thermal throttling and app crashes.

nodes.label: Visor Wiper
nodes.description: TPU squeegee worn on index finger. Clears helmet visor in rain without stopping.

nodes.label: Bag Stabilizer
nodes.description: Pannier hooks and saddle bag locks. Prevents pendulum effect during cornering. Reduces spinal strain.

nodes.label: Backpack Chest Clip
nodes.description: Distributes backpack weight across chest. Prevents forward-lean posture causing lower back pain.

nodes.label: TGPWU
nodes.description: Telangana Gig and Platform Workers Union. Organised Dec 25 and Dec 31 2025 nationwide strikes.

nodes.label: Dec 31 Strike 2025
nodes.description: Nationwide delivery worker strike protesting 10-min model and Gig Worker Brutality. Metro cities.

nodes.label: Social Security Code 2020
nodes.description: Mandates platforms contribute 1-2% annual turnover to worker social security fund. First federal recognition of gig workers.

nodes.label: Rajasthan Gig Workers Act 2023
nodes.description: First state-level legislation. Proposes Welfare Board and portable worker ID. Rules not yet notified as of 2026.

nodes.label: 3D Printing
nodes.description: Additive manufacturing as bottom-up mitigation tool. PETG, TPU, ASA filaments used for rider ergonomic accessories.
